channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Tarcísio prega combate à intolerância em evento com judeus
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas defended the fight against antisemitism and religious coexistence during a meeting with the Jewish community at Fisesp. He stated that the state will not tolerate attacks against Jews and highlighted that São Paulo was the first Brazilian state to officially adopt the IHRA definition of antisemitism. The event marked Tarcísio’s first official engagement after confirming his 2026 re-election candidacy.

item.title: Dino é o relator de 3º inquérito contra Lulinha no STF
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino has been assigned as rapporteur for the third Federal Police inquiry against Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha), investigating alleged influence peddling to benefit 3Structure IT Ltda., a company with R$81 million in federal contracts. Lulinha's defense lawyer claims the PF lacks solid evidence and that the inquiries aim to influence the 2026 elections. President Lula stated his son will be treated without special consideration but acknowledged he is being politically targeted.

item.title: O JOGO DO PODER | Mendonça Resiste, Milei Vai pra Cima de Lula e Eleições 2026 | Factual News 📱
item.description: The video discusses Mendonça's resistance and Milei's aggressive strategy against Lula, setting the stage for the 2026 Brazilian elections. It focuses on the political clash between conservative and progressive figures, with implications for the country's future direction. The content suggests rising polarization as candidates position themselves for the upcoming vote.

item.title: Amiga de Lulinha troca defesa após novos inquéritos no STF
item.description: Lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger changed her legal team following new STF investigations into alleged influence peddling involving Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha) and Antônio Carlos Camilo Antunes (Careca do INSS). Lawyer Bruno Salles departed the defense team, and Roberto Podval, former lawyer for Banco Master founder Daniel Vorcaro, assumed leadership. Roberta is suspected of paying tens of thousands of reais to Marco Aurélio Santana Ribeiro (Marcola), Lula’s chief of staff, between 2023 and mid-2026, and of introducing Lulinha to Careca do INSS, which she denies was for business purposes.

item.title: Plenário aprova alterações pontuais em resoluções das Eleições 2026
item.description: The TSE unanimously approved minor adjustments to the 2026 General Elections resolutions, notably changing the deadline for distributing Electoral Fund resources from August 30 to September 8 of the election year, benefiting female, Black, and Indigenous candidacies. The amendment also allows FEFC resource transfers exclusively to majoritarian candidates in a runoff, provided the transfer occurs within five days after the first round and is stipulated in the party's distribution criteria.

item.title: ‘Vai piorar’: os vários abacaxis que colocam o STF sob pressão
item.description: The STF faces mounting pressure from institutional challenges, such as the debate over a code of ethics for justices, and political factors, especially the 2026 election, which increases candidates' interest in pressuring the Court. The imprisonment of Jair Bolsonaro and controversies involving Justice Alexandre de Moraes in the Banco Master case keep the tribunal at the center of public debate. The relationship with the TSE may also generate new conflicts, depending on the future composition of the Senate.

item.title: Por que investigação contra Lulinha tem muito potencial para causar estragos
item.description: The investigation into Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha) poses significant political risk to President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, as it revives the PT’s historical association with corruption allegations, a narrative frequently used by opponents such as Sergio Moro and Deltan Dallagnol. While concerns about electoral motivations exist, journalist José Benedito da Silva emphasizes that the probe must be conducted with transparency and independence by the Federal Police to prevent misinformation and minimize political damage.

item.title: TSE confirma multas aplicadas por irregularidades em eleições gerais e municipais
item.description: The TSE unanimously upheld fines imposed by the Regional Electoral Courts of São Paulo and Paraná for irregularities in the 2022 general elections and 2024 municipal elections. Fernanda Marçal Nunes Hourneaux de Moura was fined R$ 17,144.03 for exceeding legal donation limits in 2022, with the violation recorded in her electoral registry but without resulting in ineligibility. Fernanda Leite Carvalhaes was fined R$ 2,000 for irregular electoral propaganda conducted in a religious temple (a common-use asset) in Londrina, PR, in 2024, including social media dissemination that improperly expanded her reach to voters.

item.title: União Brasil rompe com PL e complica Flávio no Rio
item.description: União Brasil announced the end of its alliance with the PL in the Rio de Janeiro gubernatorial race, adopting a neutral stance in the state election. This decision weakens the candidacy of Douglas Ruas, state deputy running under the PL, and complicates the electoral plans of Flávio Bolsonaro, who sought the party's support to strengthen his base in the state.

item.title: Presidente do TSE reafirma compromisso da Justiça Eleitoral com eleições seguras e transparentes
item.description: TSE President Minister Kassio Nunes Marques reaffirmed the Electoral Justice's commitment to secure and transparent elections in 2026, highlighting advances in planning, technological innovation, and risk management during the opening of the second judicial semester. Initiatives mentioned include the completion of the first phase of the Electoral Assistant, testing for its launch, development of the institutional chatbot, and the Future Elections Project, all aimed at bringing Electoral Justice closer to society.

item.title: Avante oficializa Augusto Cury como candidato à Presidência
item.description: The Avante party officially nominated writer and psychiatrist Augusto Cury as its presidential candidate during a national convention held at the São Paulo Legislative Assembly. Cury advocated for adopting a semi-presidential system in Brazil and ruled out any alliance with Novo’s presidential candidate, Romeu Zema, for a joint ticket.

item.title: Nunes Marques suspende efeito de condenação e Acir Gurgacz concorrerá às eleições de 2026
item.description: Minister Nunes Marques of the STF granted a preliminary injunction to suspend the effects of the conviction of former senator Acir Gurgacz, allowing him to register as a candidate for the Senate from Rondônia in the 2026 elections. The decision was based on the imminent deadlines for party conventions (August 5) and candidate registration with the Electoral Justice (August 15), as well as claims of judicial nullity due to alleged lack of jurisdiction by the STF. This marks Gurgacz's sixth criminal revision request, all prior ones having been denied.

item.title: Candidato à Presidência, Augusto Cury quer Tarcísio como 1º ministro
item.description: Augusto Cury, the presidential candidate from the Avante party, announced that if elected, he would invite São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas to serve as Brazil's prime minister under a proposed semipresidential system. Cury positions himself as a third-way alternative, advocating for a blend of right-wing and left-wing values, and stated he has not yet chosen a running mate but suggested it could be a woman. His candidacy must be registered by August 15.

item.title: União Brasil abandona palanque do PL no Rio e dificulta cenário de Flávio Bolsonaro no Sudeste
item.description: União Brasil announced it will leave its coalition with PL in Rio de Janeiro and remain neutral in the 2026 state election, according to party leaders speaking to Folha. The move complicates Flávio Bolsonaro's electoral outlook in the Southeast, following the earlier loss of Senator Cleitinho’s (Republicanos) support in Minas Gerais on the same day.

item.title: Avante oficializa candidatura de Augusto Cury à Presidência
item.description: The Avante party officially nominated psychiatrist Augusto Cury as its presidential candidate, with Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) in attendance. Cury positioned himself as a third-way alternative, advocating for a blend of right-wing and left-wing values, and proposed reforming Brazil’s presidential system into a semipresidential one, offering Tarcísio the role of prime minister. He has not yet chosen a running mate but hinted it could be a woman, with registration due by August 15.

item.title: João Campos: Lula derrotou Bolsonaro por aliança com Alckmin e PSB
item.description: João Campos, PSB candidate for governor of Pernambuco, stated that Lula defeated Bolsonaro in 2022 solely due to the alliance with Geraldo Alckmin and the support of the PSB. The comment was made during an interview on UOL's Frente a Frente program.

item.title: Após ser preso e ver ruptura do União Brasil com o PL, Canella deixa disputa ao Senado pelo Rio
item.description: Márcio Canella of União Brasil withdrew from the Rio de Janeiro Senate race after being arrested for illegal firearm possession, which damaged his popularity. He will now run for the Rio de Janeiro Legislative Assembly (Alerj), aligning strategically with the party's national president, Antônio de Rueda, who is running for the Federal Chamber. His decision was also influenced by the União-PP federation's distancing from Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) presidential campaign, which severed his ties to Douglas Ruas's (PL) gubernatorial bid.

item.title: Entidades e advogados reclamam de fala de Lula de que criminalistas não sabem ‘defender inocente’
item.description: Lawyer associations and criminal attorneys criticized President Lula’s statement that criminal lawyers don’t know how to defend the innocent and only defend criminals. The São Paulo chapter of the OAB, the Federal OAB Council, Abracrim, and the IDDD condemned the remark as prejudiced, stigmatizing, and incompatible with the Democratic Rule of Law, demanding a public retraction and emphasizing the essential role of criminal defense, citing Lula’s own imprisonment and subsequent acquittal in Operation Car Wash as evidence of its importance.

item.title: TSE e AGU firmam acordo de boas práticas sobre IA nas Eleições 2026
item.description: The TSE and AGU signed a cooperation agreement to regulate and monitor the use of artificial intelligence in the 2026 elections, aiming to prevent disinformation and safeguard democratic integrity. The agreement was signed by Ministers Kassio Nunes Marques (TSE), Jorge Messias (AGU), and Ricardo Lewandowski (AGU’s Democracy Observatory). The partnership will produce a best practices guide for parties, candidates, digital platforms, and civil society, addressing risks such as deepfakes, illicit automation, and manipulative microtargeting.

item.title: Avante oficializa candidatura de Augusto Cury a presidente em convenção com funk e Tarcísio no palco
item.description: The Avante party officially launched writer Augusto Cury’s presidential candidacy at a convention in the São Paulo Legislative Assembly, attended by Governor Tarcísio de Freitas, who publicly endorsed Cury, signaling a shift in his political stance. Cury advocated for a semipresidential system, naming Tarcísio as a potential prime minister, and called for a 'national pact' to reduce polarization, alongside proposals for entrepreneur schools and banks in communities, schools, and churches.

item.title: Augusto Cury é oficializado como candidato do Avante à Presidência da República
item.description: The Avante party officially nominated writer and psychiatrist Augusto Cury as its presidential candidate at a convention in São Paulo. Cury proposed shifting Brazil from a presidential to a semi-presidential system, with a prime minister to manage national affairs, and suggested São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas as a potential candidate for the role. He emphasized priorities including support for 32 million neurodivergent Brazilians, educational reform, and the expansion of full-time and technical education.

item.title: A declaração de Nunes Marques, presidente do TSE, sobre as urnas eletrônicas
item.description: TSE President Nunes Marques stated that Brazil's electoral system is a "heritage of democracy" and defended its transparency during the Court's reopening. His remarks came in response to Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's doubts about electronic ballot integrity. The event launched the National Week of the Electronic Voting System, emphasizing transparency and civic education.

item.title: Aliado de Flávio no Rio, Canella desiste de candidatura ao Senado
item.description: Marcio Canella, former mayor of Belford Roxo and União Brasil member, announced he will not run for the Brazilian Senate in 2026 and will instead seek re-election as a state deputy in the Alerj. The decision was made jointly with his political allies, including gubernatorial candidate Douglas Ruas and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, following negotiations for the majoritarian ticket. Canella’s withdrawal comes after he was targeted by Federal Police in July in a money laundering investigation involving illegal weapon possession, leading to his arrest and subsequent release by Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes.

item.title: TSE: sósia de Trump, candidato a deputado declara R$ 1,6 milhão em bens
item.description: Plínio Vicentin, a Donald Trump look-alike running under the ballot name 'Plínio Trump', has officially filed his candidacy for federal deputy in Minas Gerais with the Novo party, declaring R$1.6 million in assets to the TSE. His declared holdings include a R$110,000 land parcel, two houses worth a combined R$1.3 million, and two vehicles valued at R$110,000 and R$100,000. The candidacy registration is pending review by the Electoral Justice, with the August 5 deadline approaching and 142 federal deputy candidates already registered in Minas Gerais so far.

item.title: Augusto Cury propõe semipresidencialismo e diz que chamaria Tarcísio para ser primeiro-ministro
item.description: Augusto Cury, the Avante party's presidential candidate, proposed adopting a semipresidential system in Brazil, with a president handling state and military affairs and a prime minister managing national governance. He stated he would nominate São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas for the prime minister role if elected. The remarks were made during the convention confirming his candidacy, with Tarcísio present but not publicly reacting to the proposal.

item.title: Na volta do TSE, Nunes Marques defende urnas eletrônicas: ‘patrimônio da democracia brasileira’
item.description: TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques defended electronic voting machines as 'patrimony of Brazilian democracy' during the opening of the second forensic semester, stressing transparency, auditability, and technological evolution to strengthen public trust in elections. The statement comes amid attacks on the electoral system, including false claims by Flávio Bolsonaro and a failed attempt by U.S. officials to challenge the voting process. The TSE had previously urged the minister to publicly defend the electronic voting system, which he had not done despite misinformation being spread.

item.title: No TSE, Kassio defende urnas como "patrimônio da democracia"
item.description: TSE President Justice Kassio Nunes Marques defended electronic voting machines as a heritage of Brazilian democracy during the opening of the judiciary's second semester. He highlighted the National Week of the Electronic Voting System, featuring public demonstrations and educational activities, and stated that Brazil is less than 60 days away from the 2026 general elections, with the Electoral Justice prepared to act with technical quality, accessibility, transparency, and citizen experience.

item.title: PP esconde o jogo após saída de Cleitinho e ainda não lança Aro
item.description: The PP has not yet officially nominated Marcelo Aro as Minas Gerais gubernatorial candidate, despite him being the top choice to replace Cleitinho after his withdrawal. The União-Progressista federation avoided specifying Aro’s role in the convention, keeping negotiations open with Republicanos and PL for a right-wing alliance where Aro would support Flávio Bolsonaro for Senate. Aro broke with Governor Mateus Simões (PSD) to align with the right-wing opposition, ruling out a ticket with the current state executive.

item.title: Por que bolsonaristas voltaram a defender cloroquina e tratamento precoce contra a Covid
item.description: Anthony Fauci's Senate testimony, in which he invoked the Fifth Amendment over 100 times, was seized upon by Brazilian bolsonarists as evidence of a alleged cover-up regarding Covid-19 origins and treatments, reigniting denialist defenses of hydroxychloroquine, ivermectin, and claims that vaccines are part of a deceptive narrative. Eduardo Bolsonaro and Nikolas Ferreira led the resurgence of this rhetoric, asserting that Jair Bolsonaro 'was always right' and demanding apologies from Globo, Lula, and others for deaths allegedly caused by vaccination and restriction policies.

item.title: Lula oficializa candidatura à reeleição, mas toma ‘puxão de orelha’ de Janja
item.description: President Lula officially launched his 2026 re-election bid, reiterating his criticism of violence against women. During the event, he called First Lady Janja to speak, but ended up being playfully reprimanded by her — a moment dubbed a 'pull on the ear'. The incident drew attention for blending serious political messaging with informal family dynamics.

item.title: Cury é oficializado candidato à Presidência pelo Avante
item.description: Writer and psychiatrist Augusto Cury was officially confirmed as the Avante party's presidential candidate during a national convention in São Paulo. Previously unaffiliated with any party, Cury stated he had sought an electoral alliance with Romeu Zema, governor of Minas Gerais. His candidacy brings a figure from the self-help genre into Brazil's political arena.

item.title: Lançamento da Missão: Renan Santos rejeita ‘terceira via’ e faz críticas a lideranças políticas
item.description: Renan Santos officially launched his 2026 presidential candidacy, rejecting the notion of a 'third way' and positioning himself outside traditional political blocs. He directly criticized Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro, and Sergio Moro, accusing them of representing a worn-out politics tied to entrenched interests. His speech aimed to establish a discourse of rupture with Brazil’s political establishment.

item.title: Cobrado por colegas do STF, Nunes Marques defende urna eletrônica e diz que sistema é patrimônio da democracia brasileira
item.description: TSE President Minister Kássio Nunes Marques defended the electronic ballot box as a patrimony of Brazilian democracy, announcing the National Week of the Electronic Voting System to demonstrate its robustness and transparency. He emphasized that public demonstrations aim to increase societal knowledge of the electoral process and strengthen trust in elections, following attacks by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, who claimed the machines originated from Smartmatic and were linked to Venezuelan election fraud — allegations already debunked by the TSE.

item.title: Kassio reabre trabalhos do TSE e defende transparência das urnas para garantir confiança em eleições
item.description: The president of the TSE, Kassio Nunes Marques, reopened the tribunal’s work and defended transparency of electronic voting machines as a key pillar for public trust in elections. He stated that the court should promote public demonstrations of the electoral system’s functioning to strengthen democratic legitimacy. The statement was made on March 8, 2026.

item.title: Junio Amaral diz que saída de Cleitinho é "frustrante" para a direita
item.description: The withdrawal of Senator Cleitinho Azevedo (Republicanos) from the Minas Gerais gubernatorial race was labeled 'frustrating' by federal deputy Junio Amaral (PL), a leading Bolsonarist figure in the state. His departure, which had been leading in polling, creates uncertainty and fragmentation on the right in Minas Gerais, with Marcelo Aro (PP) emerging as a potential candidate to garner support from Republicanos and part of the PL, while Vice Governor Mateus Simões (PSD) remains in the race with backing from Governor Romeu Zema (Novo).

item.title: Democrata oficializa candidatura de Wilson Grassi Júnior à Presidência
item.description: The Democrata party has officially nominated veterinarian Wilson Grassi Júnior, 56, as its presidential candidate for the 2026 elections. Grassi previously ran for federal deputy in 2022 (Partido Verde) and city councilor in 2024 (PRTB), without success. The nomination was approved at the party’s national convention in Rio de Janeiro last Sunday, marking the first time the party — founded in 2008 as the Brazilian Women’s Party — has fielded its own presidential candidate.

item.title: Dino é sorteado relator de 3º inquérito pedido pela PF para apurar tráfico de influência de Lulinha
item.description: Justice Minister Flávio Dino was randomly assigned as rapporteur of a third Federal Police inquiry investigating alleged influence peddling involving President Lula's son, Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha). The case was reassigned from Justice André Mendonça after the PF submitted requests in a different format, triggering a random draw at the Supreme Court. This move heightened tensions between Mendonça and the PF, which has demanded reports and questioned staff changes at INSS over fears of interference.

item.title: Álvaro Dias desiste da disputa ao Senado pelo Paraná após liderar pesquisas
item.description: Álvaro Dias (MDB) announced his withdrawal from the Senate race in Paraná, as stated in a post on his official Instagram profile on Monday afternoon (3). Despite leading in opinion polls, the former senator decided not to run for re-election.

item.title: Augusto Cury descarta chapa com Zema para Presidência: "Não evoluiu"
item.description: Augusto Cury ruled out forming a single ticket with Romeu Zema for the 2026 elections, citing the latter's lack of response after proposing a union. Cury said Zema 'did not evolve' and lamented not receiving a scheduled call, despite calling the idea intelligent for Brazil. He confirmed his presidential pre-candidacy under Avante, with registration due by August 15, and outlined a government plan centered on a national pact with experts to develop Brazil into a first-world nation by 2050.

item.title: PSD oficializa candidatura de Eduardo Braide ao governo do Maranhão
item.description: The PSD officially nominated Eduardo Braide as its candidate for governor of Maranhão, with Elaine Carneiro as vice and André Fufuca (PP) and Lahésio Bonfim (Novo) for the Senate. Braide, re-elected mayor of São Luís in 2024, leads in polls and frames his campaign as opposition to the state’s traditional PT stronghold, rejecting PT alliances and lacking declared support from Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Tereza Cristina diz que "ainda tem espaço" para negociar vice de Flávio
item.description: Senator Tereza Cristina (PP-MS) stated there is still room to change the PP's neutrality stance and join Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL-RJ) presidential ticket as vice president, despite the party maintaining its neutral position. She noted that the deadline for party conventions is this Wednesday (August 5) and that, although chances have diminished, there remains space until the final moment for a reversal. Her assessment takes into account the electoral calendar and the August 15 deadline for candidate registration.

item.title: Lancaster MotorSport chega embalada com Daniel Lancaster, André Moraes Jr. e Flávio Abrunhosa para a reta decisiva do Endurance Brasil
item.description: Lancaster MotorSport competes in the Santa Cruz do Sul round of the Endurance Brazil championship with drivers Daniel Lancaster, André Moraes Jr., and Flávio Abrunhosa, following their victory at the Mil Milhas do Brasil. The team retains the same driver lineup for the second consecutive year, aiming for consistency in the season’s final stretch and unveiling a new visual identity for car #22, supported by new sponsors.

item.title: Lobista de Careca do INSS mandou dinheiro para assessor de Lula
item.description: Businesswoman and lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger made payments of tens of thousands of reais to Marco Aurélio Santana Ribeiro, known as Marcola, former Chief of Staff to President Lula, between January 2023 and July 2026. The exact amounts remain undisclosed and are under Federal Police investigation, linking Roberta to the INSS fraud case involving 'Careca do INSS'. The issue caused concern within the PT during Lula’s re-election convention in August 2026, as it risks associating the government with corruption scandals.

item.title: Oppo amplia aposta no Brasil com linha Reno 16 e acessório inédito para selfies. Veja ficha técnica
item.description: Oppo expanded its presence in Brazil with the launch of the Reno 16 smartphone line, featuring two models (Reno 16 and Reno 16 F), and introduced the innovative Oppo Bubble accessory — a magnetic rear-view display for selfies using the rear camera. The company emphasized Brazil as one of its top five global markets, investing in local production, sales channels, and after-sales support.

item.title: MDB oficializa candidatura de Ramuth a vice na chapa de Tarcísio à reeleição em SP
item.description: The São Paulo MDB officially nominated Felício Ramuth as the vice-gubernatorial candidate on the re-election ticket of Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) for the 2026 elections, following approval in party conventions held in July and August. The party also ratified 86 candidates for state deputy and 69 for federal deputy, with potential to reach 91 and 71 respectively, adhering to the legal limit of seats in contention plus one. Approximately 30% of the slots will be filled by women, as mandated by electoral law.

item.title: Augusto Cury confirma candidatura à Presidência sem anunciar vice
item.description: Writer Augusto Cury confirms his presidential candidacy under the Avante party at a convention in São Paulo, without yet announcing his running mate. He mentions having discussed a potential joint ticket with Romeu Zema, but says the idea likely did not materialize. Cury currently holds 1% in voter intention polls, technically tied with other candidates within the margin of error according to the BTG/Nexus survey.

item.title: Patrimônio de Jaques Wagner cresce 630% em oito anos enquanto senador é investigado no caso Master
item.description: The declared wealth of Senator Jaques Wagner (PT-BA) rose from R$3.3 million in 2018 to R$24 million in 2026, a 630% increase, as he faces investigation by the Federal Police in Operation Compliance Zero over alleged corruption tied to Banco Master. Wagner denies wrongdoing and vows to prove his innocence; the case saw partial lifting of secrecy by Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça, revealing messages and spreadsheets.

item.title: Projeto da escala 6x1 é ativo político para Lula e preocupa oposição, avaliam parlamentares
item.description: Lawmakers assess that the proposal to abolish the 6x1 work schedule, pushed by labor unions, could serve as a political asset for Lula in his 2026 reelection bid. The measure, aligned with workers’ demands, is expected to strengthen his electoral base and raise concerns among the opposition, which views the issue as a potential vote-splitter.

item.title: TSE receberá do TCU lista de gestores com contas irregulares
item.description: The TSE will receive from the TCU a list of officials with accounts judged irregular over the past eight years, as required by the Clean Record Law. The document will be delivered by TCU President Minister Vital do Rêgo to TSE President Minister Kassio Nunes Marques and will assist the Electoral Justice in evaluating candidacy registrations. Inclusion on the list does not trigger automatic ineligibility, which must be determined case by case by the Electoral Justice.

item.title: Tebet defende recursos diretos a municípios e ataca "emendas secretas"
item.description: Simone Tebet, PSB Senate candidate from São Paulo, advocated for direct federal funding to municipalities, criticizing parliamentary amendments as 'secret' and opaque. She stated that the federal government has 200 billion reais in discretionary funds for infrastructure, but Congress controls 260 billion of these funds without transparency, claiming the money 'drips into the pockets of many people'.
